text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Crown Prince Abdullah will make an official visit to Lebanon on Thursday accompanied by a 140-member delegation.
- The European envoy to the Middle East, Miguel Angel Moratinos, arrives in Beirut on Friday on a three-day official visit.

- The five-nation group monitoring the ceasefire in Lebanon will discuss on Monday an Israeli complaint against Lebanon after three guerrilla bombing attacks killed four civilians and wounded two others in south Lebanon last Wednesday.
- A U.S. non-governmental organisation calls for improved relations between Lebanon and the United States.
- Israel shells areas in south Lebanon.
- Five opposition deputies question the government about its interference in labour unions and judicial affairs.
